verdict.rationale: The `skills/` folder is described as harness-agnostic and "shared verbatim by every harness." Porting never touches `SKILL.md` files, and the same skills load in Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI (via the `~/.agents/skills/` alias), Devin and Hermes' native loader, with evals run across Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. That clearly delivers the core goal of one skill folder working beyond a single vendor, though each harness still needs its own install and a bootstrap injector for auto-triggering. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that skills conform to the named open Agent Skills specification (frontmatter and format compliance), and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-tool portability.
